critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/ai/lessons requires field name 'detail' (not 'content'). Frontend/API consumers must use 'detail'. Consider accepting both aliases for consumer-friendliness or documenting clearly.

GET /api/ai/status returns model 'gemini-3.5-flash' which is not a valid Google model name (real models: gemini-1.5-flash / gemini-2.0-flash / gemini-2.5-flash). This is only a default value but may confuse users; recommend switching default to gemini-2.5-flash.
